title: BHMarketer TechBullion FAQ Generator: Question Search and FAQ Schema Generation for TechBullion Press Releases
description: The BHMarketer TechBullion FAQ Generator is a question search tool for BHMarketer.ai's TechBullion press release service. A user types a question in plain English and the tool returns the matching official answer from 40 FAQs with a match-confidence score from 0 to 100. It also generates the FAQ, in full or by category, as Markdown, JSON, FAQPage JSON-LD or HTML. Covers the service, buying and pricing (packages from around $40 to $90 per post), crypto press releases and crypto presale campaigns. Includes identical TypeScript (NPM) and Python implementations, a 40-entry FAQ dataset and a 40-question search benchmark. Not affiliated with TechBullion. Built by BHMarketer.ai.
